title: Draughtsman document
description: A Draughtsman diagram: a typed graph of nodes and edges plus a small header. This JSON form is the interchange format (REST, MCP, export); the same field names are used by the C# records in Draughtsman.Core and the TypeScript types in web/src/model/types.ts. Geometry is in canvas units (CSS pixels at zoom 1) and is always absolute, including for nodes inside containers; a node without geometry has not been laid out yet.

schemaVersion.description: Gates migrations. Every bump ships a migration; old files always open.

theme.description: Optional document-level diagram-theme token overrides, token name to value. A colour-valued override takes the same forms as an element style colour: a CSS colour literal or a theme token reference of the form token:<name>. Two narrowings: a palette.<name> override is a colour literal, never a token: reference, so key order cannot change the picture; and canvasBackground and exportBackground must be hex with a leading #, because the colour of text drawn straight on a surface is derived from it, and anything else leaves that text the theme's own colour. Absent means the workspace's diagram theme applies unchanged.

id.description: Stable short identifier. Never regenerated on load so agents and the DSL can reference it across edits. Conventionally n_ for nodes, e_ for edges, c_ for containers.

kind.description: Semantic kind, from the vocabulary for the document type (src/Draughtsman.Core/Schemas/<type>.json). Unknown kinds are allowed but flagged by lint.

shape.description: Presentation only. One of rectangle | rounded | diamond | cylinder | pill | hexagon | parallelogram | document | predefined-process | manual-input | off-page-connector | delay | manual-operation | display | stored-data | multi-document | merge | extract | on-page-connector | summing-junction | or | collate | sort | loop-limit | internal-storage | card | text | image | custom:<lib>/<name>. Preparation is the hexagon (ISO 5807), not a shape of its own.

geometry.description: Absolute canvas position and size. Absent on a node that arrived without a position (DSL or Mermaid import) and is waiting for the layout step; always present once laid out.

parent.description: Id of the container node this node sits inside.

rotation.description: Degrees, clockwise, about the node centre.

nodeStyle.description: Sparse. Every field optional; absent means inherit from the diagram theme plus the kind's default.

edgeStyle.description: Sparse. Every field optional; absent means inherit from the diagram theme plus the edge kind's default.

colour.description: A CSS colour literal (a hex colour, an rgb/hsl/hwb/lab/lch/oklab/oklch/color function, or a named colour) or a theme token reference of the form token:<name>. Nothing else: a url(), a variable or any other CSS value would reach the SVG paint attributes of an export.

props.description: Free key/values preserved verbatim: owner, url, ticket, and anything an agent wants to keep.

x.description: Position across the node's width, 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge.

y.description: Position down the node's height, 0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge.

kind.description: Semantic kind, from the edge vocabulary for the document type: flow | data | dependency | association.

portRef.description: The port an edge end attaches to: the id of a port the node declares, or a derived column port on an ER entity, col:<name>. A column port is never declared: it addresses one row of the entity's props.columns by the column name, with every byte outside letters, digits, underscore and hyphen written %XX (UTF-8, upper-case hex), and resolves against the entity's own layout, so it stays attached when columns are added, removed or reordered. A name no column has attaches the end to the table, with a lint warning.

createdBy.description: User id, or agent identity for documents created through MCP.

flythrough.description: Optional camera path over the diagram, the data behind Present (docs/flythrough.md). A presentation of the graph, never part of it: no node or edge refers to it, every renderer and the Mermaid export ignore it, and a document without one is unchanged. Absent means no tour; a tour with no keyframes is absent, not empty.

keyframes.description: The stops of the tour, in tour order. Keyframe ids are unique.

loop.description: Whether the tour travels from the last keyframe back to the first and plays on. Absent means it stops at the last.

keyframe.description: One stop of a flythrough: a camera framing a rectangle of the canvas, an optional caption, and how the camera arrives and how long it stays. Timings and easing are sparse: absent means the player's default (1500 ms to arrive, 2500 ms hold, easeInOut).

caption.description: Text shown over the diagram while the camera is at this keyframe.

durationMs.description: Milliseconds the camera takes to travel here from the previous keyframe; on the first keyframe, from the last one when the tour loops. Ignored by easing cut.

holdMs.description: Milliseconds an autoplaying tour stays at this keyframe before it travels on. A presenter stepping by hand is never held.

easing.description: How the camera's progress is eased on the way here: cut jumps, the rest shape a smooth fly. Absent means easeInOut.

viewRect.description: A rectangle of the canvas in canvas units, absolute like a geometry. The camera fits the whole rectangle into whatever window plays the tour, so width and height are above zero.

aiProvenance.description: Records which agent and model created or last changed which elements, for audit in regulated environments.

elementIds.description: Node and edge ids touched by this write.
